title: Nazi submarine traffic intercepted near Patagonia

tellings.quote: intercepted Nazi submarine traffic going uh to Argentina right around Patagonia.

plain: Around 1946, Nazi German submarines were picked up travelling to Argentina, near the southern region of Patagonia. The philosopher Jason Jorjani says this on the show without saying who intercepted them or where he learned it. If true, it would mean Nazi submarines were still running secret trips to South America after the war.
